copy.headline: Bedford police arrest suspected intoxicated driver after chase ends in crash into local business
copy.caption: A 25-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of DWI early Sunday after fleeing from Bedford police and crashing into a business in the 2700 block of Brown Trail, causing extensive damage.
